notes: The manual text lists an 82 ohm resistor, but the schematic labels it 220 ohm. I used 220 because the images are the authority.
The upper block of the breadboard image is labelled rows f-j, so I mapped it to bank 'b'. Columns are counted from the left, with column 1 at the far left.

The green wire goes to column 3 (3b.g). The resistor spans columns 3 and 6 on row h. The LED's bent (longer) leg is in column 6 and its straight leg is in column 8. I took the bent leg as the anode. The black wire goes to 8b.h, which is the cathode's strip.
Circuit path: pin 2 → resistor → LED anode → LED cathode → GND.
The MKR 1000 is not in the catalogue, so I added it as a new part type with ports taken from the pin labels in the diagram.
The USB power/programming cable and the laptop are not drawn in the circuit images, so I left them out.
